title: Polynomial-time computability of the pipeline output
statement: The Boolean function computed by the specified pipeline on finite bit strings has a polynomial-time algorithm: there are a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, on every input $z$, the machine halts within $C(|z|+1)^c$ steps and outputs the one-bit string containing the pipeline’s Boolean value on $z$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is any finite bit string.
The output is the one-bit string containing the pipeline’s Boolean value.
There exist a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine and natural numbers $C,c$ giving the time bound $C(|z|+1)^c$.
caveat: The formal statement names the pipeline function, but its defining construction is too large to restate faithfully in this short paragraph.
